US Visa Policy May Reduce International Student Enrollment

A report indicates that stricter visa policies in the United States could significantly impact the enrollment of international students. The new regulations are expected to deter prospective students from pursuing educational opportunities in the US. This potential decline in international enrollment could have broader implications for US universities and the global exchange of students. The report highlights a growing concern among educational institutions about the future influx of foreign students.
